newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady but the naphtha and fuel oil markets carried a softer undertone on Tuesday, traders said.
Naphtha held steady, but the undertone remained soft with crude weaker and cheaper alternative feed-stocks keeping petrochemical buyers relaxed.
Gasoline was stable. On Rotterdam barges an anticipated pick up in demand from the U.S. and tighter fob cargo supplies saw Eurograde barges for early May bid up to around $193 fob.
Gas oil was unchanged on steady premiums and unchanged futures.
Asian demand continues to draw material eastwards, underpinning the local market.
Fuel oil was quiet in dull trading amid a bearish tone especially on cargoes where concern about whether Singapore will hold up dominates.
